learner_operation: Read both signed summands, identify their exponents, increase each exponent by one and divide by the new exponent, then combine both antiderivatives and one arbitrary constant. For radio, distinguish this result from errors in signs, powers, factors or constants.

fixed_features.feature: Two signed power-rule integrals with no exponent -1
fixed_features.justification: e-371 and tutorial 701 introduce sum/difference decomposition; logarithms/substitution would add operations.

fixed_features.feature: One constant term, unit-magnitude nonconstant coefficient, five-choice radio or externally completed blank in normal moderate families
fixed_features.justification: q-71167, q-71169 and q-133291 establish complete moderate contracts; tutorial 703 introduces nonunit power coefficients later. Unlabelled two-radical banks are replay-only.

fixed_features.feature: R variable positive; B independent variable t
fixed_features.justification: Positive variable makes square-root power identities unambiguous; B retains derivative-function notation from q-133291.
